name: create_page_api_changelog
transcript_text:
Maya: We've been making API breaking changes with no changelog page. We need to create an API Changelog page documenting all the breaking changes since v1.
Nate: Yes, create it and add the v2 breaking changes we discussed: the auth header rename and the pagination cursor change.

confluence_workspace_pages.title: API Documentation
confluence_workspace_pages.content_html:
Auth Header

Pass the Bearer token in Authorization header.

expected_proposals.new_text:
# API Changelog

## v2.0 Breaking Changes
- Auth header renamed from X-Auth-Token to Authorization: Bearer
- Pagination switched from offset-based to cursor-based
